usage: train_local.py [-h] --job JOB [--data DATA] --output OUTPUT
                      [--device {cpu,mps,cuda}] [--resume-from RESUME_FROM]

在自己的CPU/MPS/CUDA上重做固定配方；不連Modal或HF、不啟動遠端工作。

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --job JOB
  --data DATA
  --output OUTPUT
  --device {cpu,mps,cuda}
  --resume-from RESUME_FROM
                        同一配方的既有best.pt/last.pt目錄；輸出仍另立新目錄

usage: chat.py [-h] --model-dir MODEL_DIR --messages MESSAGES
               --asset-dir ASSET_DIR
               [--task {text,tool_call,tool_reply,tool_concept,tool_missing,tool_unavailable,tool_unsupported,vision_clothing,vision_relation,ocr,voice_qa,voice_topic_continuation}]
               [--image IMAGE] [--audio AUDIO] [--roi ROI]
               [--image-layout IMAGE_LAYOUT]
               [--modality-message-index MODALITY_MESSAGE_INDEX]
               [--max-new-tokens MAX_NEW_TOKENS] [--device {cpu,cuda}]
               [--threads THREADS] [--tools]
               [--manifest-sha256 MANIFEST_SHA256] [--repo REPO]
               [--revision REVISION] [--prefix PREFIX] [--output OUTPUT]
               [--history-output HISTORY_OUTPUT]

Generate from verified from-scratch safetensors with real public conversation
history. Use --history-output to save the actual messages for the next CLI
turn. A later typed rewrite retains audio on its original user message. Public
HF fetching requires an explicitly supplied immutable commit; no release is
assumed.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model-dir MODEL_DIR
                        Directory containing the three safe payloads and
                        manifest
  --messages MESSAGES   JSON list of public messages ending with the current
                        user
  --asset-dir ASSET_DIR
                        Root for relative image/audio asset paths
  --task {text,tool_call,tool_reply,tool_concept,tool_missing,tool_unavailable,tool_unsupported,vision_clothing,vision_relation,ocr,voice_qa,voice_topic_continuation}
                        Preprocessing/task metadata, never an answer lookup
  --image IMAGE         Public relative image path inside asset-dir
  --audio AUDIO         Public relative audio path inside asset-dir
  --roi ROI             Public x1,y1,x2,y2 pixel ROI
  --image-layout IMAGE_LAYOUT
                        JSON file containing public slot geometry
  --modality-message-index MODALITY_MESSAGE_INDEX
                        Original user-message index for a new multi-turn asset
  --max-new-tokens MAX_NEW_TOKENS
  --device {cpu,cuda}
  --threads THREADS
  --tools               Enable the bounded calculator and same-core second
                        generation
  --manifest-sha256 MANIFEST_SHA256
                        Optional external SHA-256 pin for the manifest itself
  --repo REPO           Optional public HF owner/name model repository
  --revision REVISION   Required with repo: immutable lowercase 40-hex commit
  --prefix PREFIX       Safe-export directory inside the public HF repository
  --output OUTPUT       Also save the complete JSON result to this file
  --history-output HISTORY_OUTPUT
                        Save actual continued messages as a JSON list for
                        another turn
